name: operator-kit-remotion
description: The render half of the pipeline — one composition, driven by authored data.

scripts.render:16x9: npm run prepare-data && remotion render SceneReel out/w10-16x9.mp4
scripts.render:9x16: npm run prepare-data && remotion render SceneReelVertical out/w10-9x16.mp4
scripts.render: npm run render:16x9 && npm run render:9x16
scripts.render:with-audio: npm run prepare-data && npm run prepare-audio && npm run render
